exposure: history of cesarean delivery before 32 WG
trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) or elective repeat cesarean delivery (ERCD) in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: The study included 168 pregnant patients aged 18 years or younger, with a history of cesarean delivery before 32 WG via low transverse incision, and currently pregnant with a single child in cephalic presentation.
finding: Among patients with a history of preterm cesarean delivery, 67.9% of those attempting TOLAC achieved a vaginal delivery with a low rate of maternal and fetal complications.
mod_finding: A vaginal delivery rate of 67.9% was observed among patients attempting TOLAC, with a low rate of maternal and fetal complications, suggesting that a history of preterm cesarean delivery should not be a barrier to TOLAC.
